title: docs: srt and vtt transcription output is AssemblyAI-only
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Corrected the multipart transcription recipe and OpenAPI description: `srt` and `vtt` response formats are supported only by `assemblyai/*` transcription models. The recipe now points readers to `GET /v1/models` and its `supported_endpoints` field to find transcription models. Its example uses `openai/whisper-large-v3` instead of `openai/gpt-audio-mini`, which is a text model and returns 400 on `/v1/audio/transcriptions`.
